subject: SIG: Secure SDLC evidence for PoC - code review / CI-CD / secrets / change mgmt
messages:
From: Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@finedge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Request for Secure SDLC Evidence — FinEdge PoC

Hi Neha,

As part of our SIG assessment for the FinEdge PoC (finedge-prod-account), we need to collect Secure SDLC evidence related to code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change management. Can you please provide the following items or point me to a single package where your team keeps them?

Requested evidence (high priority for our security review):
- Code review policy and a sample PR export showing reviewer approval / checklist (recent example preferred)
- CI/CD pipeline description and gating controls (e.g., SAST/SCA gates, automated tests, deployment approvals)
- Secrets management: which stores you use (KMS/HashiVault/AWS Secrets Manager), rotation policy, and an example of rotation schedules or logs
- Change management records for production releases (ticket exports or runbook showing approval flow)
- Any automated enforcement (e.g., secret scanning, branch protection rules) and example scan report

If you can deliver a single zipped evidence bundle or a shared Drive link by EOD Wed 19 Mar that would be ideal. If anything needs a short walkthrough, happy to set a 30-min slot.

Thanks,
Marina Gomez
Security Program Manager
FinEdge Inc
marina.gomez@finedge.com

Attachment: SIG-sections-secure-sdlc.pdf (PDF - 120KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@finedge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for Secure SDLC Evidence — FinEdge PoC

Hi Marina — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Vivek and Hannah to assemble the evidence; Rishi included to keep the commercial record up to date.

Action items we will deliver by Wed EOD (target):
- Vivek: code review policy, sample PR export, and SAST/SCA gating descriptions
- Vivek: CI/CD pipeline diagram and gating configs (pipeline readme)
- Eng: secrets management summary + rotation docs (KMS config and rotation summary)
- Hannah: change-management exports (tickets + approval audit) and any policy text

A couple of quick clarifications so we provide the right artifacts:
1) For "sample PR export" — do you need the full commit diffs or a redacted HTML export that shows reviewers, timestamps, and approval checks?
2) For change management, do you prefer a CSV export of release tickets or the corresponding runbook + audit log entries?

We will stage a shared Drive folder and attach the manifest in a follow-up. If you want the 30-min call, please propose times — otherwise we'll push the bundle and a short readme.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@finedge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 19:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for Secure SDLC Evidence — FinEdge PoC

Hi all — attaching the first set of artifacts into the Drive folder Neha will share. Quick summary of each attachment so Marina has context:

Attachment: code-review-guidelines.pdf (PDF, 45KB) — Our code review policy (required approvals, checklist items). TL;DR: all change to main requires 2 reviewers, one must be from a different team; no direct pushes to protected branches.

Attachment: sample-pr-1234.diff (text, 12KB) — Redacted PR export showing reviewer comments, approvals, and CI status. Sensitive sections redacted.

Attachment: cicd-pipeline-readme.md (text, 8KB) — Pipeline stages: build -> unit tests -> SAST (Snyk + custom rules) -> SCA -> integration tests -> canary deploy -> manual approval for prod. SAST gates are configured to block merge on high findings.

Attachment: terraform-templates.zip (zip, 220KB) — Infrastructure-as-code for our deployment pipeline (examples of pipeline config and approved runners).

Attachment: kms-rotation-summary.txt (text, 6KB) — KMS key rotation cadence (90 days), last rotated 2025-01-12, automated rotation via internal jobs; KMS keys used for envelope encryption of tokens and DB credentials.

Notes:
- Secret scanning: we run pre-commit checks (git-secrets) and a scheduled repository secret-scan (trufflehog + custom rules). We will include the latest scan report separately.
- Commit signing: currently we require signed commits for releases to main (branch protection rule enforces GPG/SSH attestations for release merges).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1FinEdgeShared/0B2_redwood_sdlc_evidence

Let me know if you need the raw pipeline YAMLs; we can provide redacted versions.

— Vivek
Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@finedge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2025 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for Secure SDLC Evidence — FinEdge PoC

Marina / Neha,

I've exported the change-management tickets and approval audit as requested. Attachment: change-management-export.csv (CSV, 42KB) — includes ticket IDs, submitter, approver, timestamps, and deployment tags for the last six production releases.

Also linking the internal runbook for emergency changes and our release approval checklist in the Drive folder. For compliance, we keep a 3-year audit trail of approvals and deploy artifacts.

If you want deeper logs (e.g., internal CICD audit events), we can provide a timeboxed export — let me know the date range.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of IT Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@finedge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2025 17:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for Secure SDLC Evidence — FinEdge PoC

Thanks for the quick turnaround — I downloaded the Drive bundle and reviewed the artifacts. A couple follow-ups before we mark this section of the questionnaire complete:

1) Secret scanning: can you provide the most recent scheduled scan report (we need evidence that leaked secrets are detected) and an example of an automated rejection/block (e.g., pull request blocked because of detected secret)
2) Commit signing: please confirm where the policy is enforced (branch protection configuration or CI check) and, if possible, a short example of a signed-commit trace for a release

If it's easier, let's do a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow morning PT to show the pipeline gating and secret-scan behavior in real-time. My availability: Thu 20 Mar 09:00–11:00 PT.

Attachment: SIG-sections-secure-sdlc.pdf (PDF - updated 19 Mar with pointers)

Regards,
Marina

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@finedge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Mar 2025 17:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for Secure SDLC Evidence — FinEdge PoC

Marina — thanks, we can cover those items. Plan / next steps: 

- Vivek will drop the latest secret-scan report (secret-scan-report-20250319.pdf) and a redacted PR showing a blocked merge (we'll include the CI failure message) by EOD Thu 20 Mar.
- We'll also include a branch-protection export and a short trace of a signed commit used in a recent release.
- I'm booking a 30-min walkthrough at 09:30 PT on Thu 20 Mar (you confirmed 09:00–11:00 PT) — calendar invite sent separately.

Links: Drive bundle (same): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1FinEdgeShared/0B2_redwood_sdlc_evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4512
Jira ticket for follow-up evidence export: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-314

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
